Cycle Unmapped Thursday Rides

Minnetonka, MN

No-dropBeginner friendly

Cycle Unmapped Thursday Rides is a road, mountain bike and social group ride in Minnetonka, MN. It meets every Thursday, 5:30 pm gather, 6:00 pm roll (spring and summer), starting at Unmapped Brewing Co.. Expect about 11–20 miles, Road A ~17 mph, Road B ~13 mph, social ~10 mph, MTB at Lone Lake Park.

About the Cycle Unmapped Thursday Rides group ride

Four options leave the brewery at once: two road groups, a mountain bike group at Lone Lake Park, and an 11-mile social ride. All no-drop. Helmets required. Buy-one-get-one beer after.
